html_reuse_strategy: 7-step conversion (verified against screen_3.1.1, 3.4.1, 3.5.3, 3.18.1, 3.2.3 code.html): 1. TOKENS FIRST — the export is `cdn.tailwindcss.com` + an inline `tailwind.config` (darkMode:'class') in EVERY code.html. An earlier port (09-01) already landed in web/src/index.css: `--st-*` vars + `@theme inline` (lines ~1560-1735: all M3 color roles bg-surface-container-lowest/text-on-surface/border-outline-variant/primary/tertiary, 8 sem pairs, sem-*, font + `--text-*` type scale). Delta to add from the v6 export config (extracted verbatim, e.g. 3.4.1: colors on-surface #E2E2E6, primary #78f5e5, surface-container-lowest #0c0f11, sem-amber #F59E0B, sem-blue #3B82F6, sem-deepgreen #059669, sem-slate #64748B; fontFamily {display-xl, display-xl-mobile, headline-lg, headline-lg-mobile, title-md, body-md, body-sm, label-caps, code-sm, chip-status, tabular-stat-md/lg}; fontSize {display-xl 48/56/700 -0.02em, headline-lg 32/40/600, body-md 16/24, body-sm 14/20, label-caps 12/16/500 +.05em, chip-status 10/12/500); spacing {micro-1 0.25rem, micro-2 0.5rem, unit-3 0.75rem, unit-4 1rem, unit-5 1.25rem, unit-6 1.5rem, unit-8 2rem, unit-10 2.5rem, unit-12 3rem, gutter-mobile 1rem, gutter-desktop 1.5rem, page-max-width 75rem}. ADD: `--spacing-micro-1/2`, `--spacing-unit-3..12`, `--spacing-gutter-desktop`, `--spacing-page-max-width` (or --max-width-page-max), `--font-chip-status` + `--text-chip-status`, `--font-tabular-stat-md/-lg`, `--text-display-xl-mobile`, and fix divergences: font-code-sm 11px (current port has 13px), headline-lg-mobile 26px (current 24px), primary #59d8c9 → #78f5e5 (update --st-* dark + light sheets from the export config). Delete the Google-Fonts `` tags from exports — the app self-hosts via @fontsource-variable hanken-grotesk/inter/jetbrains-mono (already in package.json; policy: never Google CDN). 2. MARKUP HARVEST — copy the `` inner HTML of the 1440 populated folder per spec id as the JSX shell: classes are pure Tailwind class strings (verified: `bg-surface-container-lowest/70 backdrop-blur-xl`, `font-label-caps text-label-caps tracking-wider uppercase`, `data-active-classes` on nav, ZERO `dark:` anywhere) and compile verbatim against the @theme tokens. Mechanical replaces: class→className, for→htmlFor, aria-*/role keep, `` self-close, `style=""` (rare, 2 occurrences found in 3.5.3) → cn(). No inline `
risks: Icon fork: spec mandates lucide but the export rendered Material Symbols. 292 distinct glyphs — converting all is the largest single conversion cost. Mitigation: iconMap.js alias module + lazy per-screen conversion.

Coverage asymmetry vs spec §2.6 universal rule: 26/99 folders are 390 mobile, only 3 folders are 768 and 1 is 1024 (3.4.1) — the spec demanded every screen at all 4 viewports; the export does not deliver that. Tablet layouts for ~60 screens must be derived, not copied.
Light theme: only 2 of 99 folders are light (3.3.1, 3.18.1) and even they hardcode `<html class='dark'>` — light correctness rides entirely on the token sheet.
Empty/loading states: exported only for 3.4.1 and 3.5.1 (2 folders); the §2.7 per-screen states (loading/empty/error) must be grown from the design language for the rest.

Token drift: the worked 09-01 port (--st-* #59d8c9 primary, font-code-sm 13px, headline-lg-mobile 24px) differs from this v6 export (#78f5e5, 11px, 26px). Either values update everywhere or the ported screens keep stale tokens — pick the export as source of truth and batch-update index.css.
The '3.18.1-light' folder is the ONLY light settings render; PRIVACY/LIBRARY/MY-AGENT etc. light states unverified.
